This is the event:

posts.author: Coolie
posts.body:
Considering it is not a battle that can be fled from, simply turn the switch on at the start of the battle. There is no need to wait for the HP of the enemy to be zero to trigger it, since that is a required outcome to avoid a game over.
You may need to restructure your event to handle what happens when the switch is on, via another event page. Erasing the event doesn't seem like the right call.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
1 - Your troop event isn't happening because the battle ends as soon as the boss dies, the event never has a chance to run. Like
@Coolie
said, just turn on the switch at turn 0 instead (or do it on the map event, after the Battle Processing command).
2 - Your conditional branch wouldn't doing anything because it's on a page set to event touch. That can't change anything about the event just sitting there on the map, you'd have to run into it a second time.
3 - The correct way to do this is to make a second page on the map event that has no graphics or event commands and is action trigger, and give it the condition of the Dragon Slain switch.

So in the end I just did the following:
1. Remove the conditional branch and just left the battle processing and added a condition to turn self switch A to ON
2. a second event page with nothing in it which is active only if the self switch A is ON.
Now it is working as intended, thanks a lot
